svg.title: A change in nav-mesh verified in game-client, in a 104-package dependency graph
svg.text: Changing nav-mesh, deep in a real dependency graph
Verifying it in game-client only needs the packages in between. Its other dependencies stay pre-built binaries.
$ conan workspace add --ref nav-mesh/3.2 && conan workspace add --ref game-client/7.0
$ conan workspace complete && conan workspace super-install
other consumers, new binaries from CI
